newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Utilities agrees to buy gas system.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Utilities agrees to buy gas system.

text.p: Citizens Utilities said on Friday it agreed to acquire a natural gas distribution system owned by St. John the Baptist Parish, in Louisiana.
In a statement, the company said the purchase price for the system, which serves 2,250 customers, was $2.1 million.
On completion of the transaction, the system will become part of Citizens' Louisiana Gas Service division, it added.
The parties expect to complete the transaction by October 31. Citizens Utilities is a telecommunications company with utility assets.
